reconciledDefects.finding: Code hardcoded SC/ST => +5 and OBC => +3 globally across all recruitments.
reconciledDefects.rootCause: getAgeRelaxationYears used static switch statement without checking recruitment rules.
reconciledDefects.remediation: Deleted getAgeRelaxationYears. Relaxation must now be supplied by explicit official EligibilityRule objects of type AGE_RELAXATION with verified source evidence. If no rule exists, relaxation is strictly 0.

reconciledDefects.finding: Missing category defaulted to UR, missing isPwBD/isExServiceman defaulted to false, experience defaulted to 0.
reconciledDefects.remediation: Absent sensitive profile attributes now strictly remain null or UNKNOWN. Rules requiring missing facts return MISSING_FIELD diagnostics.

reconciledDefects.finding: Matching engine synthesized fake eventId using cycleId + Date.now().
reconciledDefects.rootCause: evaluateCareerSignalPersonalization did not mandate canonical eventId from caller.
reconciledDefects.remediation: CareerSignalView now strictly mandates and receives real canonical eventId from verified CareerSignalEvent. ViewId is deterministically ${userId}_${eventId}.

reconciledDefects.finding: Event ID only used first 16 characters of documentSha256, causing collisions for multiple events in same PDF.
reconciledDefects.rootCause: Event ID did not bind semantic event keys or event types.
reconciledDefects.remediation: computeCareerSignalEventId now binds cycleId + documentSha256 + eventType + semanticEventKey.

reconciledDefects.finding: RECRUITMENT_CYCLE_STATUS retained UPCOMING, ACTIVE, IN_SELECTION, CLOSED as enum members while report claimed 12 different states.
reconciledDefects.rootCause: Legacy enum members were preserved alongside canonical 12-state enum.
reconciledDefects.remediation: Removed legacy members from exported canonical enum. Legacy strings are normalized at input boundary only via normalizeCycleStatus.

reconciledDefects.finding: FINAL_RESULT_DECLARED suppressed process signals as if closed.
reconciledDefects.rootCause: Reducer grouped FINAL_RESULT_DECLARED with CLOSED and set processUpdateSignalActive = false.
reconciledDefects.remediation: FINAL_RESULT_DECLARED keeps processUpdateSignalActive = true. Only CYCLE_CLOSED definitively terminates the cycle.

reconciledDefects.finding: OBC_CL matched OBC reserved seats; WOMEN horizontal quota was not strictly checked against male profiles; vacancy deduplication was unverified.
reconciledDefects.rootCause: evaluateApplicableVacancies grouped OBC_CL with OBC_NCL and did not check row.horizontalCategory === WOMEN.
reconciledDefects.remediation: OBC_CL is strictly isolated from OBC_NCL quota. WOMEN quota rejects male profiles. Deduplication prevents counting duplicate rows.

reconciledDefects.finding: Having zero matching vacancy rows automatically forced matchResultState to NOT_ELIGIBLE.
reconciledDefects.remediation: Separated eligibilityStatus (recruitment rule qualification) from vacancyApplicabilityStatus (seat availability). Zero seats does not make an applicant legally ineligible.
